name: Engine Connecting Rod
description: I-beam connecting rod with 145 mm centres: 45 mm big-end bore, 22 mm small-end bore, and cap-bolt bosses with through holes.

steps.instruction: Create the big-end boss, a 62 mm diameter cylinder 22 mm thick.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the connecting rod's big-end boss: a solid cylinder of radius 31 mm and height 22 mm, axis along Z, centered at the origin (spanning Z=-11 to Z=11).
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the big-end boss — a 62 mm diameter disc, 22 mm thick, centered at the origin.

steps.instruction: Add the I-beam shank toward the small end.

transcript.user_prompt: Add the I-beam shank running toward the small end along X: a central web 115 mm long (X), 6 mm wide (Y) and 18 mm tall (Z), plus top and bottom flanges each 115 mm long, 22 mm wide and 4 mm thick centered at Z=7 and Z=-7. Center all three at X=77.5 so the shank spans X=20 to X=135 and embeds into the big-end boss.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the I-beam shank — web plus two flanges forming an I-section from X=20 to X=135, merged into the big end.

steps.instruction: Add the small-end boss at 145 mm centres.

transcript.user_prompt: Add the small-end boss: a cylinder of radius 17 mm and height 22 mm centered at X=145, Y=0, overlapping the end of the shank so the centre-to-centre length is 145 mm.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the small-end boss at X=145 — the rod now has its 145 mm centre distance.

steps.instruction: Add two cap-bolt bosses flanking the big end.

transcript.user_prompt: Add two cap-bolt bosses flanking the big end: boxes 26 mm (X) by 16 mm (Y) by 22 mm (Z) centered at Y=32 and Y=-32, merging into the big-end boss.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the two bolt bosses on either side of the big end, ready to take the cap bolts.

steps.instruction: Bore the big end for the 45 mm crank pin.

transcript.user_prompt: Bore the big end for the 45 mm crank pin: cut a 22.5 mm radius hole straight through along Z at the origin.
transcript.assistant_message: I bored the 45 mm big-end hole through the boss — 8.5 mm of wall remains around the bore.

steps.instruction: Bore the small end for the 22 mm wrist pin.

transcript.user_prompt: Bore the small end for the 22 mm wrist pin: cut an 11 mm radius hole straight through along Z at X=145.
transcript.assistant_message: I bored the 22 mm small-end hole — it matches the piston's wrist pin.

steps.instruction: Drill the two cap bolt holes along the rod axis.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill the two cap bolt holes: 4.5 mm radius holes with axes along X (the rod axis), straight through each bolt boss at Y=32 and Y=-32, Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled both 9 mm cap bolt holes through the bolt bosses, parallel to the rod axis.
